scenario: Missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired credential (also: the account was deactivated or the underlying grant revoked so the token no longer resolves to authority).

body.title: Unauthenticated
body.message: credential is missing, unknown, revoked or expired; rotate or re-issue the token

scenario: Action or data outside the token's scopes, or outside the account's CURRENT authority; includes query windows beyond the token's dateRange (rejected, never clamped).

body.title: Forbidden
body.message: processing level "raw" is outside this token's declared levels

scenario: Unknown identifier - and deliberately, a restricted/internal object that is out of scope for this caller (existence is not disclosed).
Revoking or rotating an already-revoked token (including the superseded half of a rotation); Idempotency-Key reuse with a different body.
Malformed create request: label length, unknown scope enum, inverted date range, expiry in the past or beyond the maximum lifetime.

body.title: Validation failed
body.message: expiresAt exceeds the maximum lifetime of 90 days

expiresAt: must be at most 90 days after issue

scenario: Per-token rate budget exceeded (proposed: 120 requests / 60 seconds, independent of interactive sessions).

body.title: Rate limited
body.message: token tok-000042 exceeded 120 requests in 60000 ms
